KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short: Automatic Income Classification Act For Local Government Units
rows.abstract:
Proposes to institutionalize an income classification system that is reflective of the financial capability of LGUs by mandating the Department of Finance to issue the classification/reclassification standards of provinces, cities, and municipalities.
Provides for the automatic reclassification computation; and guidelines on personnel services for reclassification from fourth or lower income class to higher income classes.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROVIDING PREFERENTIAL APPOINTMENT TO APPOINTIVE OFFICERS AND
EMPLOYEES HOLDING VALID APPOINTMENTS TO THE NEW POSITIONS IN THE
APPROVED STAFFING PATTERN FOLLOWING A GOVERNMENT
REORGANIZATION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE, SECTION 4 OF REPUBLIC
ACT NO. 6656
rows.title_short:
Providing Preferential Appointment To Appointive Officers And Employees Holding Valid Appointments To The New Positions In The Approved Staffing Pattern Following A Government Reorganization, Amending For The Purpose, Section 4 Of Republic
Act No. 6656
rows.abstract:
Seeks to amend Section 4 of R.A. No. 6656 by requiring agencies to exhaust all possible means to place in the approved reorganized structure the existing personnel in accordance with the order of preference. 
Allows placement of personnel to comparable positions that are next higher in rank rather than their previous positions or in case there are not enough comparable positions or next higher positions, to the positions next lower in rank provided that safety measures are in place to ensure safety of tenure of government personnel. Placement shall be done in phases in accordance with the Implementing Rules and Regulations promulgated by the Civil Service Commission.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2023-03-06, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-03-07 and received by the Senate on 2023-03-07
